title: Figure 9: Materials property charts comparing metallic glasses with other materials
description: Two Ashby-style bubble charts captioned "Figure 9. Materials Property Charts." Chart (a) plots specific strength against specific stiffness, and chart (b) plots fracture toughness K_Ic against stiffness E (GPa) with dashed contours of equal fracture energy. Metallic glasses (yellow) and dendritic composites (red) are compared with polymers, polymer foams, biologicals, ceramics, crystalline metals, CFRP and GFRP.
